protocol.action_schedule: open-loop action=(tick + environment_seed mod 4) mod 4, shared by all guidance arms
protocol.inference: cluster bootstrap and exact sign test across 32 environment seeds; model initializations are averaged within environment seed
protocol.primary_metric: per-environment-seed mean absolute error on observation channels 0..2, averaged over 8 fixed model initializations
protocol.question: Does homeostatic state guidance reduce one-step vital-state forecast error on held-out synthetic POMDP transitions?

results.primary_interpretation: descriptive synthetic-model forecast comparison only; no policy or real-world claim
